gramlot-py-server 0.2.4 stops teaching the remote Source and follows `gramlot-examples` 0.2.7. The adapters have no code changes. It requires `gramlot>=0.2.5`.

## Documentation

- Source methods (`@source`, `remoteSource`) are not yet part of the page-writing API: they arrive together with the `remote` grammar attribute and `@endpoint`. GP-010-025 keeps its identifier and now carries only this note; the introduction, the troubleshooting page, the reference, the four adapter pages and the README no longer show the pattern. The mechanism stays: the route `POST /gramlot/source` in the five adapters.
- The sentence of GP-010-025 that described `main` moves to GP-010-005.
- The gallery family `c` is `c01`–`c08`: gramlot-examples 0.2.7 removed the remote Source example and moved the end-to-end page to `c08`.

## Other changes

- The extras `gallery` and `test` require `gramlot-examples>=0.2.7`.
